::: {#def-homogenous-random-network-interference .theorem}
# Homogeneous random network interference

An exposure mapping in an [RNNPSEM](#def-npsem-ne) exhibits homogeneous random network interference if it exhibits [homogeneous network interference](#def-homogeneous-network-interference) with respect to the set of [graph generators](#def-npsem-ne) included in the model:

$$
\mathcal H = \{\boldsymbol \psi : \boldsymbol \psi \subset \mathbf V \text{ is a graph generator} \}.
$$

An [RNNPSEM](#def-npsem-ne) exhibits homogeneous random network interference if all the exposure mappings in its structural equations do.
:::
